mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_component_interaction (id, component_id, action_name, trigger_condition, provided_content, response_text, sort_order) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.componentId}, #{row.actionName}, #{row.triggerCondition}, #{row.providedContent}, #{row.responseText}, #{row.sortOrder}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE component_id=VALUES(component_id), action_name=VALUES(action_name), trigger_condition=VALUES(trigger_condition), provided_content=VALUES(provided_content), response_text=VALUES(response_text), sort_order=VALUES(sort_order)

INSERT INTO knowledge_component_relation (id, interaction_id, target_component_id, effect_text, condition_text, sort_order) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.interactionId}, #{row.targetComponentId}, #{row.effectText}, #{row.conditionText}, #{row.sortOrder}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE interaction_id=VALUES(interaction_id), target_component_id=VALUES(target_component_id), effect_text=VALUES(effect_text), condition_text=VALUES(condition_text), sort_order=VALUES(sort_order)
